what: Finalize substeps are not represented in the registry
scenario_or_breakage: With a single step-5 sentinel written at Step 5 entry, a pause during OOS filing or plan publication can compute Step 6 as next unfinished and skip 5b/5c work
suggested_fix: Do not use one entry sentinel for all Step 5, or add routed registry/sentinel coverage for 5b, 5c, and 5d with save/resume tests

what: Referenced step bodies contain Bash boundaries but the plan updates only SKILL.md
scenario_or_breakage: A pause request inside brainstorm, sketch launch, dialectic, or split-path reference bodies is not checked at those Bash boundaries, so pause can be delayed or state can be saved after more work than intended
suggested_fix: Add the referenced files to the plan and insert the canonical pause-check/sentinel prelude at every runtime Bash block, or centralize the prelude in a shared sourced helper used by those blocks

what: /larch:pause needs ISSUE_NUMBER in current-design-env but Step 0 writes env before issue binding
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed pause skill treats missing ISSUE_NUMBER as no live design session, so pause can no-op after issue binding unless another writer refresh occurs
suggested_fix: Add a Step 0b follow-up write-design-current-env.sh invocation immediately after ISSUE_NUMBER is bound, passing --issue-number "$ISSUE_NUMBER" and --claude-pid "$PPID"
